summary: SVRN, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, attaching a press release announcing completion of an initiative it led to build out and secure the multi-party computation (MPC) operator network behind NEAR Protocol's Chain Signatures. SVRN authored the incentive program funding 17 independent operators, guided it through NEAR governance, vetted onboarding operators, and now runs its own node. No securities transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing notes incorporation by reference into existing Form F-3 registration statements and is a routine foreign private issuer current report, not a special situation.
